text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Give it everything! Every, every, last bit of it!!!
Let out everything I've worked for up until now!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...! Haha!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!!
The one victorious is—”

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Seriouslyyy...?
Wait, what? C.B.... Are you serious...?

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
“No way...
I was certain she'd become a Derby Umamusume...—”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh…… S-cchi was so close……!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But this was a great race too...!
Ace-chan has more than proved how strong she is...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...!!
I gave it everything I had... and I still lost...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Daaammiiiit...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I'm really frustrated, too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, even more than that—
it was incredibly passionate.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
All that's left now is the Kikuka Sho.
—Next time, I'm going to win.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on...!
I'll return the favor right back to you!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nice.
——I'm getting fired up.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Those two... they lost, so why do they look
so full of life...?

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"...Ace-san.
Why are you so...—"

When I went out to welcome Katsuragi Ace
after the fierce battle—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“......I'm sorry, Trainer.
Even after you cheered me on so much, I—”
choice_data_list: ...When we lose is when we must hold our heads high.

text_block_list.text:
I saw up close how Katsuragi Ace fought with
every ounce of her strength. Could such powerful
running really be all lost in defeat?

—That's not true. Not in the slightest.
If it's Katsuragi Ace, she will surely
take today's defeat and grow even stronger...!!
choice_data_list: If it's you, you can move "forward"...!
If it's you, you can move "forward"...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...You really do believe in me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Ace's Friend
text_block_list.text:
—Ace-cchi—!!
—Ace-cha—n!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: You two...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Great job, Es-cchi! That was so close...!
Still, you looked super cool! I totally fell in love with your running!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible race...!!
No matter what anyone says, Ace-chan is one of the top runners of this generation!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(These two... believe in me too.
In that case, I will————)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for coming to watch!
I'm gonna give the Kikuka Sho everything I've got, too!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: So――――keep your hopes high!!
And so, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) drew to a close—

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"—Though Mr. C.B. suffered a bitter defeat,
how will she fare in the Kikuka Sho, one wonders?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "Over long distances, it will indeed come down to a fight between Mr. C.B. and Shiina Frejus. Those two seem better suited for it. Furthermore--"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "It feels like CB's running has grown stronger and stronger through the Satsuki Sho and the Derby. We're eager to see if she can get her revenge—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(......The Kikuka Sho's distance makes it a brutally tough race for me.
Like I care, though...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd chicken out
over distance at this point...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right! 10 more reps!!

After giving Katsuragi Ace instructions for independent training,
I was rushing around the academy handling paperwork and research when—

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—So, you're really giving up on aiming
for the Kikuka Sho, then?

Hearing a conversation carried with tense undertones
from just ahead, I instinctively stop in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I'm already... at my limit...

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Competing against CB-san... and being compared to CB-san...!

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I can't take it anymore...!
I'm so sorry, Trainer...—

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. There's no need to apologize.
Let's figure out what to do next together.

"...To avoid eavesdropping any further, I silently turned on my heel.
And what welled up inside my heart was—"

"The final battle of the Triple Crown, the 'Kikuka Sho.'
Before and after it, my desire was to stay by Katsuragi Ace's side
and continue supporting her heart."
